## Part 11 - Locked mode (Safe Exam Browser), planned 2026-09-30

### §11.1 Decision

- Ask (manager, 30 Sep): campus hiring drives need exam-hall lockdown - while the paper is open nothing else on the computer works, and the candidate cannot leave until they submit. A custom desktop app only as a last resort.
- A web page cannot do this: browsers never let a page block the OS (Chrome's Keyboard Lock always lets a 2 s Esc hold out). The website can only detect and penalise, which the existing rules already do (`rule_*`, violation limit, auto-submit).
- Chosen (CJ, 30 Sep): keep every existing rule and flow as it is, and add one more per-assessment rule, **Require Safe Exam Browser**. Safe Exam Browser (SEB) is free, open-source (MPL), Windows 10 1803+/11, macOS 12+, iPadOS; it locks the machine and we build no desktop software. Rejected: our own lockdown app (months, code signing, Apple's restricted AAC entitlement); Windows Assigned Access kiosk (needs admin on every lab PC).

### §11.2 How it works

1. Admin turns on "Require Safe Exam Browser" (Odoo form and Flutter admin). Each assessment has a quit password for invigilators.
2. Candidate opens `/exam/<token>` in a normal browser: `/state` answers `seb_required` with an "Open in Safe Exam Browser" link `sebs://<api host>/api/v1/exam/<token>/seb-config` and SEB's download page.
3. SEB downloads that .seb file (plain XML plist): start page = the candidate's own `/exam/<token>`, quit password hash, quit URL, camera allowed, one display.
4. Inside SEB the app reads SEB's JavaScript API (`SafeExamBrowser.security.configKey` = SHA-256 of page URL + Config Key) and sends it with the page URL on every exam call. The server rebuilds the same settings, computes the Config Key (SEB's published algorithm, ported from Moodle and checked against Moodle's two test vectors) and compares. No match = no questions, no writes.
5. After submit the app offers "Exit Safe Exam Browser" (navigates to the quit URL, SEB closes). Invigilators can close it early with the quit password.
- Why the JS API and not the `X-SafeExamBrowser-ConfigKeyHash` header: SEB for macOS (WKWebView) never sends the header, and SEB for Windows sends it only to the page's own host; our API is on another host.

### §11.3 Wire contract

| Where | Key | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| model `assessments.be` | `rule_require_seb` (bool, default off), `seb_quit_password` (char, random default) | the rule and the invigilators' password |
| admin write (`ASSESSMENT_FIELDS`, `POST_DRAFT_FIELDS`) | `rule_require_seb`, `seb_quit_password` | editable while running, like the other rules |
| admin + candidate `rules` | `seb` (bool) | rule on |
| admin detail | `seb_quit_password` | never in any candidate payload |
| `/state` | outcome `seb_required` (8th outcome) | rule on, attempt open, request not from our SEB config. Answered before `login_required` for the candidate (and anonymous) caller, so the candidate is sent to SEB before signing in |
| every `/state` envelope while the rule is on, and `seb_required` | top-level `seb: {launch_url, download_url, quit_url}` | links for the gate and the exit button |
| candidate request body (state, begin, answer, review, submit, violation) | `seb_url` (page URL at load, no `#`), `seb_key` (`SafeExamBrowser.security.configKey`) | the proof; sent only when the SEB object exists |
| write routes | 403 `seb_required` | refused outside SEB |
| `GET /api/v1/exam/<token>/seb-config` | `application/seb` plist | 404 unless the rule is on |

### §11.4 Build steps

1. Backend: `services/seb.py` (settings, Config Key, check), the two fields, form view, write allow-lists, serializers, the `/state` gate and `_write_guard` check, the `.seb` route. Test: `tests/test_a_locked_exam_opens_only_in_seb.py`.
2. Flutter: `ProctorRule.seb`, admin switch + quit password line, `seb_{stub,web}.dart` (reads the key; boot URL captured in `web/index.html`), the key on every exam call, the `seb_required` gate screen, fullscreen rule treated as met inside SEB, the exit button on the complete screen.
3. Local gate: Odoo `--test-tags /assessments_be_v2` 0 failed; `flutter analyze` clean; `flutter test` count line.
4. Real-machine check (§11.6) on one Windows and one Mac before any campus drive.
5. Version bump + `-u assessments_be_v2` only at push to stage (new columns and a new route).

### §11.5 Known ceilings (accepted)

- The Config Key proves the right settings, not a genuine SEB binary: someone who downloads the .seb in a normal browser and knows SEB's algorithm could fake the JS object in dev tools. Upgrade path: also check the Browser Exam Key against an allow-list of real SEB builds (changes with every SEB version). Invigilators in the room cover the rest.
- The quit password hash sits in the downloadable .seb (unsalted SHA-256, SEB's format). The random default is four groups of four from 32 symbols that cannot be misread (no i, l, o or u; 80 bits), far out of reach for a sitting; one an admin types needs at least 12 characters. It changes only between sittings (`/regenerate`, or the Odoo form, both refused while a candidate is mid-attempt), and only an Admin can read it.
- Changing the quit password while candidates are inside SEB invalidates their running config: they must relaunch from the link. Do not change it mid-drive.
- On `-u`, Odoo fills the new `seb_quit_password` column for EXISTING papers with one generated value (a column default runs once). New papers each get their own. Before a drive on an older paper, set a fresh password on its form.
- The launch link's host is `web.base.url` (`get_base_url()`): on stage/prod it must be the API host (`https://projects.ethara.ai`), which SEB downloads the .seb from.
- Question images/videos (`exam_media.py`) are not gated; the question text is (it only comes through `/state` and `/answer`).
- Phones and people are not software problems: invigilators.

### §11.6 Still to prove on real machines (not provable from this Mac without locking it)

- The Flutter web app (CanvasKit) renders in SEB for Windows 3.10 (Chromium 147) and SEB for macOS 3.7 (WKWebView).
- `SafeExamBrowser.security.configKey` is set at page load and our server accepts it (Windows computes it from the load URL; path routing keeps `/exam/<token>`).
- Webcam works: Windows auto-grants; macOS needs `browserMediaCaptureCamera` and has open camera issues (seb-mac #483, #602), worst under Assessment Mode.
- The quit URL closes SEB after submit.
- S-17 confirmed 6 Oct via the prod API: the assessment detail payload carries `seb_quit_password` and `rules.seb`, so 19.0.3.24.0 and its `-u` are live. Drive runbook: Part 5 §5.9.
